title: Robust Ranking of Port Impacts from Impending Tropical Cyclones: A Two-Stage Recommendation System
abstract: arXiv:2611.07296v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a tropical cyclone (TC) threatens several ports, preparedness planning depends on anticipating which ports are likely to be affected and where disruptions may last longest. Limited historical observations at individual ports and uncertainty in landfall location make these relative impacts difficult to estimate. We use a two-stage recommendation framework that first selects candidate ports based on their proximity to the expected landfall location and then ranks them by their estimated number of impact days. Using AIS-derived impact days for 37 ports and 31 TCs in the Gulf of Mexico study region, we compare three ways of representing port--cyclone interactions: pairwise feature interactions, tree-based feature combinations, and explicit feature crosses combined with learned embeddings. translated_title: 即将来临的热带气旋对港口影响的稳健排序：一种两阶段推荐系统
translated_abstract: 当热带气旋威胁多个港口时，防备规划依赖于预测哪些港口可能受到影响以及哪些地区的干扰可能持续最久。单个港口有限的历史观测数据以及登陆位置的不确定性使得这些相对影响难以估计。我们采用一个两阶段推荐框架，首先根据港口与预期登陆位置的接近程度筛选候选港口，然后按估计的影响天数对其进行排序。基于墨西哥湾研究区域37个港口和31个热带气旋的AIS衍生影响天数数据，我们比较了三种表示港口-气旋交互的方式：成对特征交互、基于树模型的特征组合，以及显式特征交叉与学习嵌入相结合的方法。在飓风Nicole和Ian的测试中，检索阶段在登陆位置存在不确定性的情况下始终能识别出所有观测到的受影响港口。在排序模型中……
tldr: 该论文提出一种两阶段推荐系统，先根据港口与预期登陆点的距离筛选候选港口，再按预估影响天数排序，从而在登陆位置不确定的条件下稳健地预测热带气旋对各港口的影响及干扰持续时间。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage recommendation system that first selects candidate ports based on proximity to the expected landfall location and then ranks them by estimated impact days, enabling robust prediction of which ports will be affected by impending tropical cyclones and how long disruptions may last under landfall uncertainty.
